sentences.text: Thanks everyone for hopping on. Goal today is to close the pricing questions before Northwind's procurement review.
Appreciate it. We are still targeting a signature before the end of the quarter.
I'll send the updated pricing deck to Northwind by Friday.
Perfect. I'll book the security review with Dana for next Tuesday.
I can share our procurement checklist by Monday.
We should probably think about packaging tiers at some point.
I already sent the deck to legal yesterday, so that part is done.
Can you update the CRM with the new contacts?
I'll update the CRM with the new contacts by tomorrow.
I'll send the recap to Dana by Friday.
That works. One flag: legal may push back on the annual uplift.
So I'll send the recap to Dana by Friday, with the uplift options called out.
Sounds good. Anything else before we wrap?

summary.overview: Pricing alignment with Northwind ahead of their procurement review; deck, security review, and CRM updates were assigned.
